summary: Frontend-only end-to-end testing of 4 features + regression. All features passed. (1) Education RESP save-as-goal POSTs successfully and 'Education fund' goal appears in /goals. (2) Enterprise drill-in opens read-only modal for Eleanor Whitfield showing 2 members, 3 accounts, 1 goal, $1,240,500 assets, 100 score / On Track — matches expected backend data. (3) Client-welcome modal correctly suppressed for solo@compass.ca (is_client=false). Invited-client creation flow not exercised in automation (noted as limitation). (4) Cross-Border page tested for all 3 scenarios: dual (US citizen + CA resident, income 120k) → jurisdiction 'Cross-border (US person resident in Canada)', FEIE excluded, SS schedule 62=$1,877 / 67=$2,681 / 70=$3,324, 6 treaty/filing flags, treaty notes visible; US green-card non-CA-resident NY → non-zero state tax ($5,748) and federal $18,338; CA-resident only → us_tax and social_security cards NOT rendered, jurisdiction label 'Canadian resident'. (5) Regression: /retirement, /insurance, /tax, /education, /crossborder, /goals, /dashboard all load without errors. 'Cross-Border' sidebar nav link present.
